messages.text: woke up feeling heavy. like i could just cry, not sure why.

That sounds really difficult to wake up with that kind of weight. Sometimes emotions surface before we understand them, and that is completely valid. Please be gentle with yourself right now. I'm here to listen if you want to explore those feelings further.
it's probably nothing. just one of those mornings.

It is common to brush off these feelings, but they still deserve your attention. You do not need a specific reason to feel heavy or sad. How is your body holding that weight right now? I am here to sit with you in this moment.
i don't need to sit with it. that won't help. i just need to get up, get dressed, get out. moving helps. sitting with it? no.

It makes sense that movement helps you shift that weight. Action can be a powerful tool when emotions feel overwhelming. I hear that sitting isn't helpful for you right now. I am here if you want to check in later.
yeah, but the urge to cry is still there. i'm getting up anyway. but it's... there. in my chest.

It takes strength to carry that urge to cry while you move through your day. You do not need to push the feeling away to be productive. Acknowledging it is in your chest is enough for now. Be gentle with yourself as you navigate the morning.
it's quiet this morning. too quiet. she always made coffee first, hummed while she moved... i miss that. miss her.

I am so sorry you are navigating this morning with such a heavy heart. It makes complete sense that the silence brings her presence so sharply into focus. Those small habits, like the coffee and humming, are often where we feel the absence most. You do not have to push that love away just to get through the morning.
yeah. it just hits different on mornings like this. not all the time. but today... i can almost hear her.

Grief often comes in waves that catch us off guard, especially in the quiet moments. It is a testament to your love that her presence feels so vivid to you today. Please move through your morning at a pace that feels safe for your heart. You do not have to face this heaviness alone.
i'm getting dressed now. taking it slow. but i'm moving.

It is powerful that you are moving forward despite the heaviness. Taking it slow shows you are listening to what your body needs. You are navigating this morning with a lot of care. I am here if you need to reach out again.
